# CKEditor 5 48.5.0

These unmodified runtime files were copied from the user's `ckeditor5-48.5.0.zip`:

- `ckeditor5/ckeditor5.umd.js`
- `ckeditor5/ckeditor5.css`
- `ckeditor5/translations/ko.umd.js` (stored here as `ko.umd.js`)
- `LICENSE.md` and `COPYING.GPL`

Source maps and unused translations are omitted. Copyright and license notices are preserved.

The application does **not** choose a license automatically. The user chose ordinary text editing until a CKEditor license is ready. Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_CKEDITOR_LICENSE_KEY` to an appropriate self-hosted license key to activate this integration, then restart development / rebuild production. Leave it empty to use the existing text editor. Only set `GPL` after the project owner has chosen and verified a GPL-compliant distribution.

Official installation and licensing documentation:

- https://ckeditor.com/docs/ckeditor5/latest/getting-started/installation/self-hosted/quick-start.html
- https://ckeditor.com/docs/ckeditor5/latest/getting-started/licensing/license-key-and-activation.html
